acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Protein reduction and alkylation was carried out with 10 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride and 40 mM chloroacetamide by incubating them at 70oC for 5 min.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Protein reduction and alkylation was carried out with 10 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride and 40 mM chloroacetamide by incubating them at 70oC for 5 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Overnight protein in-gel digestion was carried out with 10 ng/µl of dimethylated porcine trypsin (Sigma Aldrich) in 50 mM HEPES pH 8.5 buffer at 37oC.

collision_energy.evidence: Briefly, one 350- 1,400 m/z MS scan at a resolution setting of R = 70,000 was followed by higher-energy collisional dissociation fragmentation (normalized collision energy of 26) of the 5 most intense ions (z: +2 to +5) at R = 17,500.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Briefly, one 350- 1,400 m/z MS scan at a resolution setting of R = 70,000 was followed by higher-energy collisional dissociation fragmentation (normalized collision energy of 26) of the 5 most intense ions (z: +2 to +5) at R = 17,500.

ionization_type.evidence: Elution was carried out at 250 nL/min with a 2-35% (60 min) A to B gradient (buffer A: 0.1% (v/v) FA; buffer B: 80% (v/v) ACN + 0.1% (v/v) FA) and electrosprayed to a quadrupole-orbitrap Q Exactive Plus (Thermo Fisher Scientific) MS/MS via a nano-electrospray source (positive mode, spray voltage of 2.5 kV).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Intensity-based absolute quantification (iBAQ) feature of MaxQuant was enabled [2].
